plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: one wide text column carries headline then steps, with a solid CTA pill anchored on the right and the legal line tucked in a thin strip under it, so the headline leads and the action closes.
Text over fine print: the copy column runs most of the height with legal set as a full-width footnote beneath it, sharing its left edge, while the CTA stands alone vertically centred on the right.
Three-zone strip: headline and steps on the left, a narrow fine-print column as a quiet divider, then a compact CTA on the far right, giving a clear left-to-right message, small print, action rhythm.
